title: settings.update
$comment: Source: https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/settings/update ; property table from https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/settings/object . Settings is a singleton object (no ID field). Only available to Super admin user type. Properties labeled 'required' in the property-behavior notation (connect_timeout, socket_timeout, media_type_test_timeout, item_test_timeout, script_timeout, report_test_timeout, and the timeout_* family) mean the property must always hold a value, not that it must be included in every update call; per the reference commentary, 'For update operations, a property is considered as set when setting it during the update operation.' The example update call sets only login_attempts and login_block, so no top-level 'required' array is applied here. The read-only property ha_failover_delay is omitted since it cannot be set via the API.

default_lang.description: System language by default. Default: en_US.

default_timezone.description: System time zone by default. Default: system - system default. For the full list of supported time zones refer to PHP documentation.

default_theme.description: Default theme. Possible values: blue-theme - (default) Blue; dark-theme - Dark; hc-light - High-contrast light; hc-dark - High-contrast dark.

search_limit.description: Limit for search and filter results. Default: 1000.

max_overview_table_size.description: Max number of columns and rows in Data overview and Trigger overview dashboard widgets. Default: 50.

max_in_table.description: Max count of elements to show inside table cell. Default: 50.

server_check_interval.description: Show warning if Zabbix server is down. Possible values: 0 - Do not show warning; 10 - (default) Show warning.

show_technical_errors.description: Show technical errors (PHP/SQL) to non-Super admin users and to users that are not part of user groups with debug mode enabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not show technical errors; 1 - Show technical errors.

history_period.description: Max period to display history data in Latest data, Web, and Data overview dashboard widgets. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix. Default: 24h.

period_default.description: Time filter default period. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix with month and year support (30s, 1m, 2h, 1d, 1M, 1y). Default: 1h.

max_period.description: Max period for time filter. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix with month and year support (30s, 1m, 2h, 1d, 1M, 1y). Default: 2y.

severity_color_0.description: Color for "Not classified" severity as a hexadecimal color code. Default: 97AAB3.

severity_color_1.description: Color for "Information" severity as a hexadecimal color code. Default: 7499FF.

severity_color_2.description: Color for "Warning" severity as a hexadecimal color code. Default: FFC859.

severity_color_3.description: Color for "Average" severity as a hexadecimal color code. Default: FFA059.

severity_color_4.description: Color for "High" severity as a hexadecimal color code. Default: E97659.

severity_color_5.description: Color for "Disaster" severity as a hexadecimal color code. Default: E45959.

severity_name_0.description: Name for "Not classified" severity. Default: Not classified.

custom_color.description: Use custom event status colors. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not use custom event status colors; 1 - Use custom event status colors.

ok_period.description: Display OK triggers period. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix. Default: 5m.

blink_period.description: On status change triggers blink period. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix. Default: 2m.

problem_unack_color.description: Color for unacknowledged PROBLEM events as a hexadecimal color code. Default: CC0000.

problem_ack_color.description: Color for acknowledged PROBLEM events as a hexadecimal color code. Default: CC0000.

ok_unack_color.description: Color for unacknowledged RESOLVED events as a hexadecimal color code. Default: 009900.

ok_ack_color.description: Color for acknowledged RESOLVED events as a hexadecimal color code. Default: 009900.

problem_unack_style.description: Blinking for unacknowledged PROBLEM events. Possible values: 0 - Do not show blinking; 1 - (default) Show blinking.

problem_ack_style.description: Blinking for acknowledged PROBLEM events. Possible values: 0 - Do not show blinking; 1 - (default) Show blinking.

ok_unack_style.description: Blinking for unacknowledged RESOLVED events. Possible values: 0 - Do not show blinking; 1 - (default) Show blinking.

ok_ack_style.description: Blinking for acknowledged RESOLVED events. Possible values: 0 - Do not show blinking; 1 - (default) Show blinking.

discovery_groupid.description: ID of the host group to which discovered hosts will be automatically placed.

default_inventory_mode.description: Default host inventory mode. Possible values: -1 - (default) Disabled; 0 - Manual; 1 - Automatic.

alert_usrgrpid.description: ID of the user group to which the database down alarm message will be sent. If set to "0", the alarm message will not be sent.

snmptrap_logging.description: Log unmatched SNMP traps. Possible values: 0 - Do not log unmatched SNMP traps; 1 - (default) Log unmatched SNMP traps.

login_attempts.description: Number of failed login attempts after which the login form will be blocked. Default: 5.

login_block.description: Time interval during which the login form will be blocked if the number of failed login attempts exceeds the value defined in login_attempts. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix. Default: 30s.

validate_uri_schemes.description: Validate URI schemes. Possible values: 0 - Do not validate; 1 - (default) Validate.

iframe_sandboxing_enabled.description: Use iframe sandboxing. Possible values: 0 - Do not use; 1 - (default) Use.

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout with Zabbix server. Possible values range: 1-30s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

socket_timeout.description: Network default timeout. Possible values range: 1-300s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

media_type_test_timeout.description: Network timeout for media type test. Possible values range: 1-300s. Default: 65s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

item_test_timeout.description: Network timeout for item tests. Possible value range: 1-600s. Default: 60s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

script_timeout.description: Network timeout for script execution. Possible values range: 1-300s. Default: 60s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

report_test_timeout.description: Network timeout for scheduled report test. Possible values range: 1-300s. Default: 60s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

auditlog_enabled.description: Whether to enable audit logging. Possible values: 0 - Disable; 1 - (default) Enable.

auditlog_mode.description: Whether to enable audit logging of low-level discovery, network discovery and autoregistration activities performed by the server (System user). Possible values: 0 - Disable; 1 - (default) Enable.

geomaps_tile_provider.description: Geomap tile provider. Possible values: OpenStreetMap.Mapnik - (default) OpenStreetMap Mapnik; OpenTopoMap - OpenTopoMap; Stamen.TonerLite - Stamen Toner Lite; Stamen.Terrain - Stamen Terrain; USGS.USTopo - USGS US Topo; USGS.USImagery - USGS US Imagery. Supports empty string to specify custom values of geomaps_tile_url, geomaps_max_zoom and geomaps_attribution.

geomaps_tile_url.description: Geomap tile URL. Property behavior: supported if geomaps_tile_provider is set to empty string.

geomaps_max_zoom.description: Geomap max zoom level. Possible values: 0-30. Property behavior: supported if geomaps_tile_provider is set to empty string.

geomaps_attribution.description: Geomap attribution text. Property behavior: supported if geomaps_tile_provider is set to empty string.

vault_provider.description: Vault provider. Possible values: 0 - (default) HashiCorp Vault; 1 - CyberArk Vault.

timeout_zabbix_agent.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (Zabbix agent checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_simple_check.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (simple checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_snmp_agent.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (SNMP agent checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_external_check.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (external checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_db_monitor.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (database monitor checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_http_agent.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (HTTP agent checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_ssh_agent.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (SSH agent checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_telnet_agent.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (TELNET agent checks). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_script.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (script items). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 3s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).

timeout_browser.description: Spend no more than timeout_* seconds on processing (browser items). Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m). Also accepts user macros. Possible values range: 1-600s. Default: 60s. Property behavior: required (must always hold a value).
